connectionString.label: Connection String
connectionString.help: Alternative to individual connection fields. Recommended for production.

embedding.provider.label: Embedding Provider
embedding.provider.help: Select your embedding provider. Ollama is great for local/air-gapped use.

embedding.apiKey.label: Embedding API Key
embedding.apiKey.help: API key for embedding provider. Not required for Ollama.

embedding.model.label: Embedding Model
embedding.model.help: Model name. Dimensions are auto-detected for common models.

embedding.baseUrl.label: Custom API Base URL
embedding.baseUrl.help: For Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM, or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

embedding.dimensions.label: Vector Dimensions
embedding.dimensions.help: Override auto-detected dimensions. Only needed for unknown models.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically capture important information from conversations.

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into context before agent runs.

autoRecallTimeoutMs.label: Auto-Recall Timeout (ms)
autoRecallTimeoutMs.help: Max time to wait for memory recall. Prevents slow embeddings from blocking responses.

asyncCapture.label: Async Capture
asyncCapture.help: Run memory capture in background without blocking agent response.

search.hybrid.label: Hybrid Search
search.hybrid.help: Combine vector similarity with full-text keyword search.

search.minScore.label: Minimum Score
search.minScore.help: Threshold for memory relevance (0-1). Higher = stricter matching.

indexType.label: Vector Index Type
indexType.help: HNSW is faster but uses more memory. IVFFlat is smaller but slower.

apiKey.description: API key for the provider (not required for Ollama)

baseUrl.description: Custom API endpoint (for Ollama, vLLM, custom providers)

autoRecallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for auto-recall. Prevents slow embeddings from blocking agent start.

asyncCapture.description: Fire-and-forget capture. When true, capture runs in background without blocking.

indexType.description: Vector index type (HNSW is faster, IVFFlat uses less memory)
